---
title: "Basketball Score Heatmap"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
    css: styles.css
    toc: false
---


Explore the distribution of home and away score combinations across the season. White tiles indicate score pairs that never occurred, while the colored heatmap highlights the most common game results.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)

games <- read_csv("Games.csv")

all_scores <- expand_grid(
  homeScore = seq(min(games$homeScore), max(games$homeScore), by = 1),
  awayScore = seq(min(games$awayScore), max(games$awayScore), by = 1)
)

density_data <- all_scores %>%
  left_join(
    games %>%
      group_by(homeScore, awayScore) %>%
      summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("homeScore", "awayScore")
  ) %>%
  mutate(count = replace_na(count, 0))

ggplot() +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(density_data, count == 0),
    aes(x = homeScore, y = awayScore),
    fill = "white",
    width = 1,
    height = 1
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(density_data, count > 0),
    aes(x = homeScore, y = awayScore, fill = count),
    width = 1,
    height = 1
  ) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#0b1345", "#2c1f66", "#6b3f90", "#dc6f2f", "#fee58c"),
    name = "Frequency",
    guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 12, barheight = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Heatmap of Home vs Away Score Frequencies",
    subtitle = "Zero-score combinations are shown in white; colored tiles reflect the number of games with each score pair.",
    x = "Home Score",
    y = "Away Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#d8d8d8", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#d8d8d8", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#ebebeb", size = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#202040"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#202040", face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold", color = "#1f2540"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```
